notes_for_editor: Conflict: the lookout-history site says Removed; a Facebook group post says a tower stands on Big Knob. The post could only be read as its opening line; a search snippet from it mentions a 4 September 2017 visit that found the tower unstaffed and abandoned, which I could not verify, so it is not in the story. Height 24.4 m is the roof top per NGS, not the cab floor. The Laurens County context PDF (its date is not visible in the text read; the 2002 in its filename is unverified) is assumed to mean this knob (same name, north of Laurens); I did not check coordinates against it. Before publishing either a 'stands' or a 'removed' line, check recent reports or NGS photos.
